metadata.title: How to Compare Cover Styles in Papira | Android Screenshot Guide
metadata.description:
In Papira’s Cover style sheet, compare the named thumbnails; the checkmark identifies the selected style. This example shows Floral Frame selected.

Still-screen guide using a real Android emulator capture of Papira 2.0.3+10 with an original demonstration manuscript and procedural cover art. No taps, style changes, book creation, exports, saved results or speed demonstration are shown. Only part of the style list is visible. This is not a live recording, and the video has no audio.
